findings.explanation: Changing the default value for ssh_source_ranges from "0.0.0.0/0" to a specific IAP range will break existing users who rely on the previous default to allow unrestricted SSH access.

impact.summary: The PR changes the default value of the ssh_source_ranges variable from '0.0.0.0/0' to '35.235.240.0/20', which will disrupt existing deployments that rely on the previous default to allow unrestricted SSH access.

dismissed.item: Change of default SSH source range from 0.0.0.0/0 to 35.235.240.0/20
dismissed.reason: This change restricts network exposure to a specific Google Cloud IAP range, which is a security improvement rather than a vulnerability.

security.summary: The diff shows a security improvement by restricting SSH access to Google IAP ranges, removing the previous 0.0.0.0/0 exposure; no other security issues were detected.
